Containers.Name: Bacula File Daemon
Containers.Description: Native Bacula 15 file daemon (bacula-fd) for Unraid. Lets your Bacula Director back up the server itself - the flash drive, VM definitions, appdata and shares - and restore files to their original locations, keeping ownership, permissions, ACLs and extended attributes. Requires a Bacula 15 Director and Storage Daemon, for example the Bacula-Server container. Settings: Settings > Network Services > Bacula File Daemon.
Containers.Requires: A Bacula 15 Director and Storage Daemon on your network
